title: Rocky Point Kayak

services.name: Kayak or SUP
services.desc: Our Level 1 Introduction to Sea Kayaking course focuses on getting paddlers comfortable with basic paddling skills. This course is taught by an experienced Paddle Canada Certified Instructor who will guide each paddler through beginner kayaking techniques and concepts. This course runs for a duration of 3 hours. Pre-requisites: None besides the minimum age of 14. Come and learn how to kayak with us. Our Level 2 Capsize Recovery course focuses on wet exits and a variety of re-entry skills. Paddlers will be given the confidence to solo rescue their capsized kayak, as well as assist other paddlers with capsized kayaks. Upon successful completion of this course, you will receive a certificate
